description.en: Creates a high-detail dialogue model for an NPC looked up by its NPC ID string, optionally set up for talking.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC ID string identifying the character to create.
Optional; whether to create it in "Talk" mode for dialogue (defaults to true).
Optional flag passed through to CMND_CREATE_CHARA (defaults to false).
Optional memory pool to allocate the model from (defaults to DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT).
Handle of the newly created character model.
